event.text: Go to the emergency department now. Your severe cramping pain, bloated belly, repeated vomiting and 3 days without a bowel movement can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent scans and hospital treatment. Don't eat or drink on the way. If you can't travel safely, or you develop constant severe pain, fever, faintness or blood in vomit or stool, call 911 instead.
